capabilities: Publish Markdown, PDF, Word and image files up to 20 MiB to a WeKnora server
Track remote parsing status separately from successful upload
Move completed unchanged files into a published folder with conflict-safe recovery
Import a source-linked catalog and graphs from a compatible snapshot endpoint
Cache original PDFs, DOCX files and images for in-vault previews
disambiguation: Not a two-way editor for remote documents: deleting a local file never deletes its remote document, and it is publication plus optional derived-data import only.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (Windows tested; macOS/Linux unverified), Obsidian 1.11.4+. In-place updates and catalog/graph import require deployment extensions beyond stock WeKnora, so users must validate the API contract before enabling continuous publication. No telemetry; only explicitly published files and search queries leave the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes and attachments to an external WeKnora knowledge base and track their parsing state on the server.

relations.evidence: Initial upload, retrieval and search use WeKnora APIs.

summary: Publishes selected vault notes and files to a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base, tracking parsing and archiving completed uploads.
